boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Skidmore traditions and recurring campus rituals, from a founder celebration to class-year events and music-making.

cards.title: Founder’s Day
cards.subtitle: Annual fall picnic honoring Lucy Skidmore Scribner
cards.notes: Watch for the early-semester gathering that recognizes founder Lucy Skidmore Scribner and connects the celebration to Skidmore’s history.
cards.short_summary: A fall welcome-back celebration centered on the College’s founder.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore says its community gathers each year for Founder’s Day; the fall-picnic version was revived in 2014.
cards.access_notes: College community event; consult the College calendar for a current date and participation details.

cards.title: May Day, Before Founder’s Day
cards.subtitle: Historic spring observance for Lucy Skidmore Scribner
cards.notes: Use the archive-backed account to see how students originally marked May Day before today’s Founder’s Day format took hold.
cards.short_summary: The historical spring predecessor to Skidmore’s founder celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore documents that students celebrated May Day each spring after a proposed Founder’s Day was declined in 1915.
cards.access_notes: Historic tradition; the source distinguishes it from the current fall Founder’s Day celebration.

cards.title: The Scribner Seminar Rite of Passage
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary first-year seminar sequence
cards.notes: First-year students can approach this required fall seminar as a shared Skidmore starting point, with topics that vary by faculty member.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive academic tradition linking every incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore states that every first-year student takes a Scribner Seminar in the fall semester.
cards.source_title: Faculty and students learning together: Skidmore’s Scribner Seminars
cards.access_notes: Required for first-year students; seminar offerings and enrollment are administered by the College.

cards.title: Big Green Scream
cards.subtitle: Basketball doubleheader, performances, and Thoroughbred spirit
cards.notes: Bring campus spirit to the traditional men’s and women’s basketball doubleheader, where student performers appear during halftime.
cards.short_summary: A February athletics celebration that mixes games, performers, and pep-rally energy.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore describes Big Green Scream as a campus-wide athletics celebration built around a traditional February basketball doubleheader and halftime performers.
cards.source_title: The big return of a big green tradition
cards.access_notes: Event timing and venue can change; check Skidmore Athletics and campus events listings.

cards.title: Skidmania’s Year-in-Music Time Capsule
cards.subtitle: Student-performed songs selected from one past year
cards.notes: Audition or attend when the Music Department selects a year and students build performances around music released in that year.
cards.short_summary: A student music tradition that reinterprets a single year’s songs.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore identifies Skidmania as a reimagined musical tradition and says its student performers present music from a selected year.
cards.source_title: Reimagining Skidmania, a Skidmore musical tradition
cards.access_notes: Auditions, performance dates, and ticketing are set by the Department of Music for each edition.

cards.title: Winter Carnival
cards.subtitle: First-year class weekend of winter events
cards.notes: Look for the first-year class council’s winter weekend, which the College describes through comedy, a dance, fireworks, and brunch activities.
cards.short_summary: A first-year-led response to the long stretch of winter.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore says Winter Carnival is a full weekend of events and activities organized by the first-year class council.
cards.access_notes: Programming is organized by the first-year class council; confirm the current schedule with Student Events.

cards.title: Spring Fling
cards.subtitle: Sophomore class celebration before finals
cards.notes: Follow the sophomore class council’s end-of-year event series, including its spring semi-formal and other activities before final exams.
cards.short_summary: A class-year spring marker hosted by the sophomore council.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore says Spring Fling is run by the sophomore class council to mark nice weather and the end of the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Event details are determined by the sophomore class council; consult current Student Events announcements.

cards.title: Fun Day on the Campus Green
cards.subtitle: End-of-semester games, music, and activities
cards.notes: Plan around the Campus Green gathering, where Skidmore lists inflatable games, a dunk tank, music, food, and other daytime activities.
cards.short_summary: The College’s named final campus celebration of the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore calls Fun Day its last celebration of the semester and lists games, music, food, and activities on the campus green.
cards.access_notes: Schedule and activity lineup vary; verify current details through Student Events.

cards.title: Wafflefest
cards.subtitle: Named Skidmore campus tradition
cards.notes: Treat Wafflefest as a named campus custom and check Student Events listings for any current iteration rather than assuming its format or timing.
cards.short_summary: A food-centered tradition identified by a Skidmore student account.
cards.evidence_claim: A Skidmore student story identifies Wafflefest among the campus’s fun traditions.
cards.access_notes: The cited account does not provide current scheduling, location, or access information.

cards.title: The Commencement Procession at SPAC
cards.subtitle: Graduates form a processional for Skidmore’s annual exercises
cards.notes: For graduating seniors and guests, follow the published Commencement schedule for procession formation and the College’s annual ceremony at SPAC.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding graduation ritual that has adapted across Skidmore’s history.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore documents its annual Commencement tradition and its graduates’ processional, with recent ceremonies held at Saratoga Performing Arts Center.
cards.source_title: Photo essay: Skidmore’s Commencement over the years
cards.access_notes: The College’s Commencement FAQ and schedule provide the current ceremony details and guest guidance.
